datasetName: Chennai Belt Express Rail Stop & Classification Foundation
operator: Indian Railways (Southern Railway, South Western Railway, South Central Railway)

openDataSources.sourceName: Indian Railways Timetable & Commercial Stop Master (CRIS / NTES)

coverage.scope: Express, Superfast, and Intercity train stops within the Chennai metropolitan commuter belt

licenseAndAttribution: Public passenger timetable data published by Indian Railways / Ministry of Railways, Government of India.
limitationsAndCaveats: No actual express train schedule or timetable trips are committed in the repository; only a catalogue of 8 commercial stops and train type ticketing rules is stored.

Strict Isolation: Express trains must NEVER be merged into suburban EMU tables without explicit train_type classification. Suburban monthly season tickets are NOT universally valid on Express/Superfast trains unless specifically endorsed for unreserved second-class coaches.
Skip-Stop Behavior: Express trains do not stop at standard suburban stations (e.g. Chetpet, Palavanthangal, Tirusulam, Urapakkam, Potheri, Villivakkam, Ambattur).
Platform and Punctuality Variability: Intercity express services are subject to national route delays and platform reassignments.
